title: 9007199254740993 = 9007199254740992 is FALSE: two integers are compared as integers

source.quote: DAX does implicit conversions for numeric or date/time types as the following table describes
source.supports: the comparison table that follows gives REAL for INTEGER compared with REAL, and INTEGER for INTEGER with INTEGER

derivation: The comparison table gives INTEGER for INTEGER compared with INTEGER: no conversion to floating point. 2^53 + 1 and 2^53 are different 64-bit integers.
notes: The control for assumptions/large-integer-equals-decimal-number: same digits, no decimal point.
